Dolphin Island.name: Dolphin Island
Dolphin Island.summary: Players care for aquatic animals while attempting to prevent the game's eponymous marine park from being demolished. Dolphin Island is a game that will teach children/players how to respect animals & nature.

Livly Garden.name: Livly Garden
Livly Garden.summary: A pet simulation based on the browser communication game Livly Island from So-net Entertainment.

Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends.name: Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends
Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends.summary:
Have fun with Hello Kitty and her Sanrio Friends

Hello Kitty returns to help out her friends any way she can in Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends. She can now help her friends out in the shopping mall and even help with their homework. Take Hello Kitty shopping, decorate her room, and choose her clothes. Loving Life with Hello Kitty & Friends features all of Hello Kitty’s best friends.

Play with Hello Kitty and her friends over five distinctive areas, including Hello Kitty’s room, the shops, the food court, and playing with Hello Kitty’s friends. In Hello Kitty’s room you can customize furniture, clothing, and accessories. At the shops you can put on unique uniforms, play fun mini-games, and help out Hello Kitty’s friends. In the food court you can work to earn Puro (the in-game currency), and play more mini-games based on the shop you choose to work in. You can then use the Puro you’ve earned to purchase goods and visit Hello Kitty’s friends.

Mega Man Star Force 3 - Black Ace.name: Mega Man Star Force 3: Black Ace
Mega Man Star Force 3 - Black Ace.summary: Mega Man Star Force returns in the most thrilling series adventure yet, delivering totally upgraded and cutting-edge online communication and device customization technologies through a portable RPG adventure that is brought to life in the iconic, action-driven Mega Man way! New to the series are "Noise Changes," random enhancements that change Mega Man's form and unlock new abilities. There are more than 100 transformations possible. Mega Man Star Force 3 will be available in two versions, Red Joker and Black Ace, each with their own unique Noise Types. Mega Man Star Force 3 blends a unique formula of RPG exploration elements with fast-paced action, as players travel and battle between coexisting worlds, the physical world and the virtual Wave World. Players will encounter enemies in the virtual Wave World and battle them on three-by-five battle grids with their Battle Card deck. Mega Man Star Force 3 also adds a new feature called "Rezon," which allow players to fill in profiles about battles and their team name/symbol.

Naruto - Path of the Ninja.name: Naruto: Path of the Ninja
Naruto - Path of the Ninja.summary: Based on episodes from VIZ Media's hit anime series Shonen Jump Naruto, the new game features a unique time-based combat system in which players must determine each character's strengths and use them accurately to help them defeat the enemy. Choosing from six available characters, players explore the Village Hidden in the Leaves and the world of Naruto as they roam across forests, fields, rivers and mountains. Along the way players encounter bosses and enemies that they must use their special techniques to defeat.

Personal Trainer - Walking.name: Personal Trainer: Walking
Personal Trainer - Walking.summary: Nintendo has trained people's brains and made fitness fun. Now Personal Trainer: Walking gives the simple act of walking a high-tech twist.

SBK - Snowboard Kids.name: SBK: Snowboard Kids
SBK - Snowboard Kids.summary: SBK: Snowboard Kids, released in Japan as Snowboard Kids Party (スノボキッズパーティー sunobo kizzu pātī?), is a snowboarding video game for the Nintendo DS released on November 22, 2005 in North America and two days later in Japan. It was also released in Europe on April 28, 2006. It is the fourth in the Snowboard Kids series following three previous games released on the Nintendo 64 and the PlayStation. Up to four people can play wirelessly with one game card. Though the name is the same as the other games, the characters are teenagers in this installment.
